0022600118.text: The Grizzlies (2-0) are off to a strong start and sit 2nd in the Southwest, half a game back, and 5th in the West, with a 1-0 road record and a two-game winning streak. The Kings (0-2) have lost both games so far, are on a two-game losing streak, and are 4th in the Pacific, 2.5 games back, and 14th in the West. Memphis is missing Zach Edey (out, ankle), Cedric Coward (day-to-day), and Karim Lopez (day-to-day, knee bruise), while Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (out, Achilles surgery), Dylan Cardwell (out, calf strain), Keegan Murray (out, ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (out, knee dislocated). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and Memphis won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, though the most recent meeting was a 123-114 Grizzlies loss in Memphis on February 23, 2026.
